text: Objectives The PhD program in Management Science and Engineering offers advanced studies with various subjects in economics, finance, business management, urban planning and design. The program provides students with solid theory and the latest development and technological knowledge. The program has an innovative and practical orientation. Students are expected to do high level research, assume leadership role in their respective fields. Duration Duration of the program is between 3-4 years with possible extension to 5 years with approval. Research Areas 1. Economics and Finance 2. Business Administration 3. Financial Engineering Credit Units Students need to successfully complete minimum 12 credits including 4 credits for core courses, and 4 credits for selective courses. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship
